newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - August 5.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - August 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:

* Malaysia announces a 2.8 billion ringgit trade deficit for June this year against a surplus of 156.2 million in May. Trade deficit in the first six months is 2.7 billion ringgit against against 687.8 million in the year-ago period
* Analysts divided over direction after Monday's 2.4 percent drop in key Composite Index to 978.56.
* Some analysts forecast a rebound, while others said curbs on dollar/ringgit swaps would continue dampening sentiment.
* "The market thinks Bank Negara's curbs on swaps is regressive," said an analyst with a Malaysian brokerage.
* Dealers said the key market index could decline another 20 points before finding strong support between 950-960
* Technology Resources Industries' 42 percent rise in profit for the first six months seen as within market expectations
